description: Bassins de rétention sur Rennes Métropole is a dataset listed in Rennes-metropole open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Rennes Métropole. Cette couche représente les bassins de rétention destinés à réguler le débit des eaux pluviales lors d'évènements pluvieux importants. Coverage: Rennes Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energie. Its keywords are santé publique et assainissement, bassin de rétention des crues. The portal shows 608 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2023-11-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ODbL 1.0 (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-rennesmetropole-fr-portal.
